question_text:
Hi Jan,

Piet Janssens received EUR 3,500 gross instead of EUR 5,000 for January. He says he worked full-time. I entered his regime change in our HR tool mid-January. Can you check what went wrong and whether we can fix it before the February closing? I've attached the email thread and his signed amendment.

Thanks,
Melanie

timeline.description: Client HR forwards the employee's complaint to Jan by email
Ticket SDW-2026-004187 received with email thread and signed amendment attached (priority high; February closing 2026-02-18)
